about: Per-model states of the old side of the quality-schema 14 -> 15 crossing. The promoted v14 baseline predates model_states, so they are measured from main's own CI MSL run and derived by the same code as a quality snapshot's; the v15 reference boundary pins this file by sha256.
caveats: main's run carries the run-phase regression this crossing's change fixes, so its watchdog kills can only make the new side look like progress
main's comparator still excludes the near-zero models by policy, so they are newly scored on the new side
omc_wall_reference is main's own OMC wall per model, unnormalized (no frame existed before v15); the first v15 promotion fixes the frame at the median of its shards' speeds against it
